en: The image depicts a large group of uniformed men, most likely postal workers or possibly railway employees, standing in front of a brick building with arched windows and a large doorway. The men are dressed in long coats and hats, with some carrying satchels and mailbags. There is snow on the ground, suggesting a winter setting. The style of the uniforms and the architecture point to an early 20th-century European or North American setting.
